articleTitle: Fuzzy Intelligence Inventory Decision Optimization Model of Sustainability and Green Technologies for Mixed Uncertainties of Carbon Emission
abstract: In many areas, carbon cap-and-trade and carbon offsets are frequent and significant mechanisms for reducing carbon emissions. Furthermore, particular capital investments in green technologies can efficiently cut carbon emissions from corporate activities. However, such capital investments are expensive, and not all businesses/company can afford them. As a result, if all members of a supply chain agree to share facility investments, the supply chain can cut carbon emissions while also increasing profit. This study utilized crisp and fuzzy models to fix perishable products in the production process. The suggested model, for study is solved using python in machine learning. To cut carbon emissions and increase the total value of the supply chain system, we planned to integrate manufacturing, distribution, replenishment, and technology. Several cases are simulated, and the key parameters are subjected to sensitivity analysis. Under various carbon emission rules, the optimal solutions and joint total profit are also compared. Companies should be able to share risks by co-investing and building sustainable supply chains as a part of the future carbon emission control trend.

articleTitle: A Grad-CAM-based Knowledge Distillation Method for the Detection of Tuberculosis
abstract: Automatic screening for tuberculosis (TB) from X-ray images using artificial intelligence techniques has attracted the attention of researchers in the fields of computing and medicine. However, existing models are computationally intensive and require high computer hardware, which limits the use of people in areas where medical resources are scarce. Another problem with the existing model is poor interpretability. The model only provides the final result and lacks intuitive information about the location of the lesion. To solve these problems, this paper proposes a Grad-CAM-based knowledge distillation method for the detection of TB. Firstly, this study used Unet to extract the lung region, avoiding the influence of regions outside the lung on the detection results. Subsequently, five models (Densenet121, Inception V3, Resnet18, Mobilenet V3, VGG16) are applied to TB detection, and the attention maps of each model are visualized using Grad-CAM. These attention maps are applied to knowledge distillation to finally obtain a lightweight interpre table TB detection model. This model achieves 91.2% and 85.7% accuracy on Shenzhen and Montgomery datasets, which verifies the effec-tiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Decision Making on Optimal Selection of Advertising Agencies using Machine Learning
abstract: The decision makers of every business firm take strenuous efforts to achieve the target of sales promotion using different marketing strategies. In recent times, advertising is becoming one of the most preferred and adopted marketing techniques to reach customers at larger magnitude. The business firms irrespective of their production sizes and scales associate with various advertising agencies to familiarize their products to the customers. The advertising strategic approach of marketing also gives rise to a decision-making problem on the optimal choice of advertising agencies as the wrong selection of the agencies harms the sales. This research paper intends to propose a decision making (DM) model integrating both multi–criteria decision methods and machine learning algorithms to make optimal selection of advertising agencies. The proposed DM model considers 25 alternatives of advertising agencies, six criteria, linguistic analytic hierarchy process (LAHP) and random forest algorithm for ranking the advertising agencies. The machine learning (ML) algorithm identifies the feasible alternatives with the help of criterion weights obtained using the method of LAHP. This method is more compatible as it minimizes the risks of decision making by grouping the alternatives into two groups of acceptance and rejection based on their likelihood. The computations are done using Python programming language especially in Google Colabs.

articleTitle: Construction Practice of Laboratory Open Management System Based on Safety Concept
abstract: University laboratory is an important place for training higher talents. The scientific and rational utilization of laboratory resources is related to the quality and quantity of talent training. Scientific co-ordination of the organization and opening of laboratories is the only way for laboratory construction, and also a necessary measure. It is the basic premise to improve the openness of the laboratory and ensure the safe operation of the laboratory. This paper discusses the current situation of laboratory safety management, puts forward specific strategy research for laboratory opening, and expounds the laboratory opening system based on security premise. This paper designs and develops a safety management information system of university open laboratory based on Web and database, which is helpful to strengthen the consciousness of experiment safety and safe operation habits of teachers and students, and provides reference for the safe opening of university laboratories.

articleTitle: Multi-Agent-Based Modeling of Deshopping Behavior Considering Two or More Shops or Web Sites
abstract: The focus of this research is on simulation modeling and a multi-agent-based system for consumer deshopping behavior. Most recent work on deshopping analysis has been focused on case studies and theory building. This study intends to propose a decision framework and computational model of deshopping that combines consumer purchase with return behavior. A multi-agent system, together with simulation and associated functions, are created. The rich detail provided by simulation modeling can contain a hybrid marketplace as elements of the retail environments and two or multiple firms, competitors, Web sites, etc. To develop this computational framework and model, several integrative frameworks for evaluating deshopping, behavioral intention, rational choice, shop or Web site choice, opinion dynamics, return leniency are employed. The simulation and modeling allow firm responses to deshopping to be simulated over time. Return leniency modeling allows firm responses to be analyzed as well. The simulation model provides a bird’s eye view of the presence, impact, and growth of consumer deshopping behavior and its effect on return policies and customer loyalty.

articleTitle: Low-code/No-code Platforms and Modern ERP Systems
abstract: The idea of low-code/no-code (LCNC) platforms is not new. It roots back in time of software engineering approach called Model Driven Development (MDD) [1]. But since new technological development, growing business demands and changes based on digital transformation and accompanying technologies are omnipresent, they will try to transform ways of modern businesses and their information system. These platforms have opened up a new world of possibilities, enabling businesses, or to be exact business/non-developer users, to develop small software solutions faster, with greater agility, scalability and smaller software development cost. This paper discusses the nature of applying LCNC platforms in the context of ERP systems. To be more precise, focus of paper is on presenting domains in which extensions or small apps can be develop by LCNC platforms and in that way improve ERP systems.

articleTitle: E-Schools Project-Framework for Digital Competencies of School Principals: Competencies in the Area of Digital Technologies in Learning and Teaching
abstract: The role of principals of schools facing digital transformation in and for the 21st century is to assure and promote effective use of digital technologies in all aspects of school functioning.Within the project "e-Schools: Development of the System of Digitally Mature Schools" (e-Schools project), which is in the second phase of its implementation in the Republic of Croatia, the Framework for Digital Competencies of School Principals has been developed. Within the Framework there are five areas of digital competencies expected from and needed by each school principal in their everyday job: (1) Planning, management and leadership, (2) Digital technologies in learning and teaching, (3) Development of digital competencies, (4) Digital culture and (5) Digital infrastructure. For each of these areas, a set of digital competencies and related key school principal tasks were identified based upon a review and analysis of the relevant literature and strategic documents and with the help and involvement of experts and the school principals themselves.In this paper, the digital competencies of school principals related to the area (2) Digital technologies in learning and teaching have been presented and elaborated. The role of school principals in promoting the use of digital technologies in schools and some related challenges has been emphasized.

articleTitle: The Effects of Structural Network Embeddedness on College Students’ intention to Volunteer Service Behavior: An Empirical Study
abstract: Volunteer service is an important carrier for college students to participate in social life, and also a symbol of social civilization and progress. Stimulating college students' voluntary service behavior can not only meet the individual emotional needs but also help to promote the whole society to improve the moral level. Through the questionnaire survey of 450 College Students in China, it reveals the influence mechanism of structural network embeddedness on the intention to volunteer service behavior, which provides a reference for more effective cultivation of college students' volunteerism. The results show that: (1) structural network embeddedness has a positive impact on the intention to volunteer service behavior, (2) emotional support has a positive impact on the intention to volunteer service behavior, and (3) structural network embeddedness can influence the intention to volunteer service behavior by influencing emotional support.

articleTitle: News Analytics to Predict Malaysian Telco Stock Price Performance: Data Visualization
abstract: The stock market refers to the collection of markets and exchanges where regular activities of buying, selling and issuance of shares of publicly held companies take place. Stock Market Index is the reading used in comparing the price of the stock market each day and it is very dynamic and susceptible to quick changes therefore a large dataset is needed to create a proper prediction model. Many believe that it follows a random walk pattern. In this project, machine learning is used so that a prediction can be made by monitoring past index patterns and predicting how they would behave in the future. Natural Language Processing is a scoring process of a word in a sentence that translates the word meaning into machine-readable value. With this, we can identify a certain topic of a stock market to be either positive or negative. Knowing these values, we can train the machine learning model to predict the price index trend and see whether news and posts related to stock price affect the market. The result of the prediction is visualized and analyzed to identify the accuracy of the data and view the disparity between the predictions and the actual value.

articleTitle: Redefining Annual Rate Occurrence (ARO) in Risk Calculation with Probability and Regression
abstract: This study converts archaic Annual Rate of Occurrence(ARO) into a novel probabilistic model with the help of a public dataset while improving Annualized Loss Expectancy (ALE). It considers internal and external influence when calculating cybersecurity risk, where granularity is its key characteristic. In addition, the exact dataset is modelled by machine learning classifiers to identify types of breaches. Though the results were less than satisfactory, it provides a framework for future studies.

articleTitle: Internet Banking Acceptance Towards Improving Sustainability: A Systematic Literature Review
abstract: Internet banking is nowadays an important platform for taking care of financial matters. Researchers have introduced the acceptance of internet banking, which allows users to fulfil their obligations without visiting a counter. Nevertheless, the lack of sustainability of internet banking acceptance can systematically present the current research. The proposed study proposes a systematic literature review on internet banking acceptance to overcome this limitation. This systematic literature review (SLR) will help practitioners to draw on the existing literature and propose new solutions based on the existing internet banking adoption. The results of this paper can help future researchers from industry and academia by providing a guide for practitioners to identify approaches to successfully implement internet banking acceptance.

articleTitle: Buying NFTs to Support Artists? The Impact of Moral Values on the Acceptance of NFTs
abstract: Non-fungible tokens (NFTs) are unique digital assets that have recently gained significant popularity, particularly in the digital art sector. The success of NFTs and other blockchain-based innovations depends on their ac-acceptance and use by consumers. This study aims to understand the impact of moral values on the acceptance of NFTs. Based on a quantitative survey with over 800 complete responses, the analysis shows that moral aspects of NFTs are indeed important for potential users. However, there is an attitude-behavior gap, as the positive impact of moral values on the intention to use NFTs is not reflected in the actual current usage of NFTs by the respondents. This study contributes to knowledge by providing new empirical data on the acceptance of NFTs and highlighting the role of moral values on the acceptance decision.

articleTitle: Trends of Academic Publications on Big Data: A Case Study of Southeast Asian Countries
abstract: This article studies the trends of academic publications on big data focusing on Southeast Asian countries. The study uses bibliometric indicators to study the pattern of publication in Scopus and Web of Science. The researcher develops a specific search string to run the data in both databases. The data found based on the information search in Scopus and Web of Science were analyzed. The list of top countries, types of documents, top subject areas, sources of the document, and funding information were listed.

articleTitle: Intelligent Transportation System: Application of Telematics Data for Road Safety
abstract: Road safety is a growing concern as the number of vehicles on road increase yearly. Road related accidents is within the top ten cause of death globally and number one cause of death for youth between the ages of 19-29 years old. With the growth of "Internet of Things" and artificial intelligence, there is a huge potential of using smart technologies to support the Intelligence Transportation System (ITS) framework through the usage of smartphone telematics devices. The aim of this study is two folds. The first is to investigate the usage of feedback to drivers through push notifications on app that will monitor the driving of each participant. The second is to propose a telematics derived Usage Based Insurance (UBI) framework. For the first objective, 60 participants took part in the approved intervention study where each participant had to install an app called SafeDriver that monitors their driving for 12 weeks. It was found that the app had made some positive changes to the driving behavior and from an exit survey, many participants were happy with this app and are willing to use it if some financial incentives were provides such as reduced vehicle insurance premiums. For the UBI, after closely examining the literature, a conceptual model was pro-posed. In summary, telematics coupled with artificial intelligence (data mining) hold a promising future in promoting a more improved road safety

articleTitle: Storytelling for Non-Fungible Token via Blockchain Technology A Case Study of Layer Randomly model for Digital Art Profile Picture (PFP)
abstract: The aim of this research are 1) to study about storytelling, non-fungible token, blockchain technology and digital art profile picture (PFP); 2) to develop layer randomly model for digital art profile picture; and 3) to create Digital Art Profile Picture from the model. Research scope is layer randomly model and 100 digital art PFP. The research result is layer randomly for digital art profile picture model, divide to 3 elements; layer randomly element, storytelling set element and digital art PFP collection element, and 125 images of digital art PFP. Research finding is using storytelling is good to convey more design set, and create many design concepts to increase a difference image, for more traits and valuable of the unique NFT.

articleTitle: A Method for the Adoption of DevOps in the Banking Industry
abstract: DevOps is the modern organizational approach to unite the agile project world with the most cost-effective and stable IT operations. Swiss financial institutions tend to have numerous legacy systems as well as specific regulatory requirements that make the shift to DevOps particularly challenging. In this paper, a new DevOps method specifically designed for the Swiss financial market was created. In order to be able to verify the benefits of the method, a survey of 53 employees was conducted within a Swiss financial institution. It was found that the existing elements of the new method provide the basis, but the description of the instantiation of the method as well as the exact room for interpretation of the legal requirements provide the additional value desired.

articleTitle: Towards Eco-Sustainability and Green Analytics Model to Measure the Performance of Big Data Systems
abstract: Many BDS is doomed to failure because of the missing knowledge on measuring the performance of BDS. The failure to identify the performance measurement and correct will make the problems worsen. This will complicate the efforts of fixing such problems and more importantly, will affect the quality of knowledge, insights, and results expected by the users in the future. In achieving durable performance, the organization needsto understand the factors that contribute to the performance of the eco-sustainability and green analytics metrics for BDS. Although the existence of its importance and awareness was largely neglected. Therefore, the eco-sustainability and green analytic measurement of the BDS is examined in this research. Measuring the BDS performance has the benefit of identifying problems and launching corrective actions before these problems happen and become worsen. The research will investigate the eco-sustainability and green analytic measures which will be proposed and used to capture performance for each process of BDS. Then, based on such measures and metrics, as well as existing performance concepts, frameworks, and models, a measurement model for BDS will be created. The model will be validated through expert evaluations and confirmatory studies with users and practitioners of BDS users. The research has a greater significance in leveraging existing performance concepts in BDS settings and the research proposes users' participation in the sustainability and continuous performance evaluation of theirBDS.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Adoption of International Standards in China Based on Big Data
abstract: National adoption of international standards is very important in developing foreign trade and promoting international exchanges. As a member of WTO, ISO, IEC and ITU, China attaches great importance to the adoption of international standards developed and issued by the international standards organizations to improve the consistency with international standards. This paper outline the legal basis, regulatory requirements and specific rules of China’s adoption of international standards, and analyzes the current situation of China’s adoption of international standards, including the overall situation, as well as the classification of standardization documents of type, field, and age of issue. Finally, the paper gives policy suggestions on balancing the level of international standards adopted by various industries, paying more attention to "speed" on the basis of "quantity", and building a new index system of standard adoption rate.

articleTitle: Practice Research on School-enterprise Cooperative Innovation and Entrepreneurship Collaborative Education Information Platform
abstract: This paper analyzes the current situation and trend of innovation and entrepreneurship education for college students at home and abroad, and summarizes the problems of innovation and entrepreneurship education for college students in China against the background of the prevalence of the COVID-19. This paper discusses and studies the cooperative education mode of college students' entrepreneurship and innovation ability training under the school-enterprise cooperation mode, the actual talent demand of industrial enterprises, and its position and role in the system of college students' entrepreneurship and innovation training. Through the design and development of a school enterprise cooperation, innovation and entrepreneurship collaborative education information platform system, we explore effective education models and methods, and provide new ideas and strategies for college students' talent training, especially the high-quality improvement of mass entrepreneurship and innovation capabilities, so as to enrich the relevant theories of innovation and entrepreneurship education guidance in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Institutional Investors and the Risk of Stock Price Collapse-Based on the Intermediary Effect of Investor Sentiment
abstract: Because of the scale advantage of institutional investors in capital, their investment behavior has attracted the attention of securities market regulators and other participants. Based on the perspective of investor sentiment, this paper makes an in-depth study on the relationship between institutional investors' shareholding and stock price crash risk, and deeply explores the relationship and transmission mechanism between institutional investors' shareholding and stock price crash risk. This paper selects A-share listed companies from 2009 to 2020 as the research sample, and finds that institutional investors exacerbate the risk of share price collapse. Through mechanism analysis, it is found that institutional investors' shareholding mainly transmits the risk of stock price collapse through influencing investor sentiment. Further research finds that the Securities Research Report released by analysts can adjust investors' expectations of stock prices through signal transmission, avoid investors' overheating and reduce irrational behaviors, which is conducive to stabilizing the stock market.

articleTitle: Determinants of Cloud Services and Customer Satisfaction in Indian Start-up Companies
abstract: The current market focuses on two critical aspects-speed and timeliness of the service providers, which are quintessential for cloud computing and service providers. This paper investigates the factors that Cloud Computing Service providers must maintain to keep their customers delighted. The review of literature carries the five most important factors cost, performance, accountability, security & privacy, and usability for cloud service customer satisfaction. This paper develops a questionnaire-based customer satisfaction model that helps cloud service providers understand the detriments of availing cloud services. The developed questionnaire was used to collect data from Indian start-ups using Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP). The determining factors of the cloud service provider for customer satisfaction are identified by the ranking method. It was found that security and privacy factors are essential for customer satisfaction for start-ups.

articleTitle: Knowledge Service of University Libraries Based on the Characteristics of Scientific Research Cooperation: Case of Wuhan University of Technology
abstract: Using the methods of social network analysis, word frequency statistics and python programming, we analyze the characteristics of university scientific research cooperation by analyzing the co-authored papers of Wuhan University of Technology, and based on this, put forward the optimization strategies of knowledge service of university libraries to help national scientific and technological innovation. Through the analysis of four dimensions, namely, the scale, type, intra-institutional co-authorship, inter-institutional co-authorship and co-authored region, the characteristics of university research cooperation are summarized and corresponding knowledge service strategies are put forward. In view of the characteristics of teacher-student co-authorship and high degree of English co-authorship, it is suggested to activate student groups and regularly carry out training camps and other research ability training. Coauthor institutions on campus are characterized by small clusters and weak integration of arts and sciences. It is suggested to set up a project database to promote the integration of different institutions by means of information technology. Based on the characteristics of university-enterprise co-authoring, intra-institutional co-authoring, intra-provincial co-authoring and domestic co-authoring, it is suggested to build regional alliance and promote the upgrading of library knowledge services through multi-force cooperation.

articleTitle: Big Data Analytics Quality Model in Enhancing Healthcare Organizational Performance: A Content Validity Study
abstract: Big Data Analytics (BDA) has the potential to deliver a comprehensive answer with improved insights into the value of the data collected in the healthcare sector. An assessment of the quality of BDA is crucial to assure that the goal of BDA as the end-to-end solution in enhancing healthcare organizations is achieved. Thus, a holistic BDA Quality (BDAQ) model needs to be developed to achieve the goal. As part of the BDAQ model development processes, this paper will highlight the content validation study. In quantitative research, survey instrument validation is important. A group of ten experts, including two academicians, two specialists, one data scientist, two subject matter experts, a BDA expert, an industry expert, a senior ICT director in healthcare, and a content validity expert, provided the data. Based on the collected data, the scores were analyzed by incorporating the Item-Content Validity index (I-CVI) and modified kappa (K) statistics. From a collection of 62 items, the content validity process removed one item and retained 61 items, while the revised items continued for further analysis. These specific content validity findings suggest that the assessed instrument can be employed to establish a degree of content validity that is acceptable. Once the verification process and analysis are done, the pilot study on the BDAQ model will begin, followed by the validated BDAQ model through the actual study.

articleTitle: Expert Review on Big Data Analytics Quality Model in Enhancing Healthcare Organizational Performance
abstract: Big Data Analytics implementation in healthcare can provide an end-to-end solution with better information value insights. This paper will highlight expert opinion in verifying the quality factors in big data analytics (BDA) that affect the performance of healthcare organizations and present the findings in developing the BDA quality model. This expert verification study was carried out through hybrid approach sessions either face-to-face or by virtual online meetings with two academicians, two specialists, one data scientist, two subject matter experts, and also as BDA expert, one industry expert, one senior ICT Director involve in healthcare, and one content validity expert. All the experts have a vast experience and implementation of BDA in healthcare. The results of these exercises have confirmed and verified ten BDA quality factors which consist of reliability, accuracy, completeness, timeliness, format, accessibility, usability, maintainability, and portability were commensurate with the research model. The analysis of this expert verification study has been done through descriptive analysis such as frequency, mean, and standard deviation. The pilot study will be commenced once the verification process and analysis are completed and the BDA quality model will be validated later through actual study.

articleTitle: Research on Practice of Adopting International Standards at Home and Abroad and the New Adoption Standard Rate System in China
abstract: International standard is the common language of the world. In order to develop foreign trade and promote international exchanges, it is very important to adopt and apply international standards. Scientific statistics and calculation of adoption standard rate can accurately understand and master the consistency of national standards and international standards. The paper gives the connotation of adoption, analyzes the policy and practice of adopting international standards in the United States, Britain and Japan, and the statistical status quo and existing problems of adopting international standards in China, finally puts forward to the new adoption standard rate system, in order to provide technical support for developing or adjusting the relevant international standard transformation and international standardization work.

articleTitle: Knowledge Mapping for Social Commerce Research:A10-year Bibliometric Analysis Using Citespace
abstract: Social commerce plays an important role in the service market and has risen in importance due to the rise of social network sites. This paper presents a comparative study of the development of social commerce driven by China’s practice and research in this field. By applying knowledge mapping, this paper makes a bibliometric analysis of 827 articles in Scopus (mostly written in English) and 673 articles in CNKI articles (written in Chinese) related to social commerce. Differences and similarities in research focus between English language papers (through Scopus) and Chinese language papers (through CNKI) are deeply explored. The results show that (1) In CNKI, research on social commerce decreases, while in Scopus, it is increasing. Now, China has the most literature on social commerce. (2) CNKI and Scopus each have their focus and complementary points. (3) The first five research topics of CNKI are group buying, social commerce, e-commerce, consumer and O2O. Scopus’s first five research topics are purchase interaction, social networking, collaborative commerce, group buying, and privacy concern. The new subdivision of social commerce (e.g., short video shopping, live shopping), mobile commerce and customer engagement are expected to become an important direction of future research. CNKI and Scopus have different and complementary focuses, and scholars should refer to both databases to better understand evolving research landscape on social commerce. This research combined with the bibliometric method is helpful for researchers and practitioners to better understand the development of social commerce.

articleTitle: An Evaluation of NoSQL Databases Using the Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP)
abstract: With the rapid growth of big data, NoSQL databases (DB) offer an opportunity to harness big data sets. The emergence of NoSQL technologies stresses the importance of performance evaluation models that aid the decision of NoSQL DB selection. The purpose of this paper is to aid the decision-maker with evaluating and selecting the most appropriate cloud NoSQL DB, with a particular focus on big data contexts. To serve this purpose, evaluation criteria for the NoSQL DB were proposed based on a critical analysis of the relevant literature. Evaluation criteria consisted of six factors: data storage and distribution, data model and design, querying, system, security, and deployment model. These factors were incorporated into the AHP to facilitate the evaluation of sampled NoSQL DBs. Results indicated that the performance of these DBs varies, and suggested that DBs are not necessarily appropriate for all use-cases.
